method: Detector/model/pins frozen in 50412e5 before any post-fix replay. All 53 eligible held-out commits replayed; inspect both sites and source diff/intent for every BLOCK. WARN selection round-robin got, click, pytest in replay/finding order, ten total. No human approval or upstream tests.

reviews.label: disagree
reviews.reason: Options.request validates and stores a request function; Options.encoding validates and stores a BufferEncoding and rejects null. These property setters have different fields, types and effects; calling encoding cannot replace request. The commit updates assertion API names, not duplicate behavior.

warnings.label: disagree
warnings.reason: getHttp2TimeoutOption selects a numeric timeout minimum; timedOut attaches lifecycle timers to a request and returns cleanup. The numeric selector cannot be replaced by request orchestration.

warnings.label: disagree
warnings.reason: HelpFormatter is a stateful help-output builder; wrap_text formats a string with wrapping rules. The helper does not replace the class's state and interface.

warnings.label: disagree
warnings.reason: RaisesExc configures exception matching/context-manager behavior; ExceptionInfo.group_contains is a boolean membership check on a captured group. Their interfaces and responsibilities differ.

warnings.label: disagree
warnings.reason: optionsToUrl validates mutually exclusive URL options and constructs a URL; Options.searchParams mutates one option and the stored URL's search state. They are not interchangeable.

warnings.label: disagree
warnings.reason: ProgressBar is the implementation class; progressbar is its public factory/context-manager API. Replacing the class with the factory removes the implementation and risks recursive construction.

warnings.label: disagree
warnings.reason: Cache pytest_addoption registers cache-specific command-line flags; logging's add_option_ini is a nested helper capturing another parser/group. It registers a different option/ini contract and is not accessible here.

warnings.label: disagree
warnings.reason: Request._makeRequest creates/sends a request and prepares headers; _onResponseBase consumes an incoming response and sets response metadata. These are distinct lifecycle stages.

warnings.label: disagree
warnings.reason: render_progress updates terminal progress output and sizing; wrap_text._flush_par updates captured paragraph buffers. Shared buffers/formatting vocabulary is not substitutability.

warnings.label: disagree
warnings.reason: pytest_configure initializes cache and registers two plugins; NFPlugin implements only new-first ordering and is already constructed by that hook. Calling the class cannot replace configuration.

warnings.reason: validateSearchParameters checks allowed scalar values without mutation; Options.searchParams parses/stores search parameters and mutates URL state. The setter is not a replacement validation helper.
